summary: Phase 4 (Beta launch + categorised feedback + public-consent testimonials + 4 premium email templates + PNG PWA icons) — ALL 18 acceptance criteria verified end-to-end. Backend: full pytest 65/65 + 6 new live integration tests = 71/71 green (2.86s). Live preview verifications: (a) GET /api/beta/status returns {total_seats:100, seats_claimed:N, seats_remaining:100-N, waitlist_size:0, duration_days:90, me:null}; (b) POST /api/beta/claim with valid {email,name} returns {result:'granted', claim_number:N, seats_remaining, expires_at:iso} AND increments seats by exactly 1 AND writes both db.beta_claims and db.entitlements (plan='beta', source='beta_launch', status='active'); a subsequent GET /api/billing/status?email returns active=true; (c) duplicate POST returns {result:'already_claimed'} with NO double-increment; (d) POST with email='not-an-email' returns 422; (e) cap path not exercised on real DB (would require 100 seats — covered by mocked-DB pytest); (f) GET /api/testimonials NEVER includes 'email' field (validated via JSON inspection on empty AND populated states); (g) POST /api/admin/feedback/{id}/publish returns 401 without Bearer, 404 with valid auth on a non-consented ticket (FB-R4MCJS proven), and 200 + {published:true} on a consented ticket which then surfaces in /api/testimonials and in the homepage TestimonialsStrip (data-testid='testimonial-card-0' rendered with the message + name + 5-star rating, no email visible on the page DOM); (h) email_service.render() returns (subject,html,text) tuples for all 4 new slugs (premium_welcome, premium_10_planet, premium_forecast, premium_compatibility) with html>3KB and text>500 chars. Frontend: /upgrade now features data-testid='beta-claim-card' prominently (progress bar shows '4/100 seats claimed · 96 left'), data-testid='beta-name-input'/'beta-email-input'/'beta-claim-btn' all wired up; clicking claim with unique email shows data-testid='beta-granted' ('You’re in — claim #5 ✨' + expiry date 8/21/2026), and a second claim with the same email shows data-testid='beta-already-claimed'. The legacy Stripe upgrade-plan-monthly/yearly cards are REMOVED; data-testid='future-pricing' grid with dashed border is shown as 'After beta · Pricing preview'. /feedback page renders data-testid='feedback-beta-ratings' section with 4 rows (rating-accuracy, rating-ui, rating-ai, rating-recommend) each with 5 stars, plus data-testid='feedback-publish-consent-box' wrapping data-testid='feedback-publish-consent' checkbox with the explicit message ('By ticking this box you consent to your review and first name being displayed on liveastrology.app and inside the app … your email is never published'). Code path FeedbackPage.tsx:78-81 implements the name-required-when-consent rule and surfaces an inline error. Homepage: when there are 0 published testimonials, [data-testid='testimonials-strip'] is absent; after admin publishes one, the strip appears with [data-testid='testimonial-card-0'] (visually inspected — 'What beta users are saying' heading + card with message + name + 5 stars). PWA: /icon-192.png, /icon-512.png, /apple-touch-icon.png all 200 image/png; /manifest.webmanifest lists PNG icons FIRST then SVG fallback (iOS A2HS friendly). Regression: home H1 'Free Birth Chart — Sun, Moon & Rising, Explained' loads with 0 console errors, hero + calculator + community section + blog previews + FAQ all render.
critical_code_review_comments: beta.py is well-scoped: idempotent claim by email (existing claim returns 'already_claimed' instead of inserting again — no double-increment risk verified live), atomic count→insert→entitlement-upsert sequence, and a clean waitlist fallback. Both db.beta_claims and db.entitlements get the same expires_at — billing/status correctly reports active=true.

GET /api/testimonials response is projected to drop the 'email' field — confirmed on both an empty result set and a populated one. No 'ticket_id' is exposed either, which is the right call for privacy.

POST /api/admin/feedback/{ticket_id}/publish correctly returns 404 (with message 'ticket not found or consent not given') when publish_consent is false — meaning an admin physically cannot publish a row the user didn't opt in to. Consent ≠ approval (published defaults to false even when consent=true) is enforced by the seed value in the FeedbackIn insert path.

FeedbackPage.tsx implements the 'name required when consent=true' rule client-side (lines 78-81) with a specific error string. Backend would still accept a consented row without a name, so this is a UX guard rather than a hard constraint — fine for the current flow.

TestimonialsStrip.tsx correctly returns null when count===0 (verified — element absent from DOM on clean home), and renders [data-testid='testimonial-card-{i}'] entries when populated. No email or ticket_id is referenced in the component, eliminating any frontend-side leakage risk.

BetaClaimCard.tsx + UpgradePage.tsx — the Stripe form is fully replaced and the 'future-pricing' grid is presented as a *preview* with dashed border, making it clear payments are not yet collected. The granted state surfaces both claim_number and a human expiry date ('8/21/2026') which matches the +90d server-side calculation.

Email templates 08-11 render with substantial content (html ~ multi-KB, text > 500 chars) and the Jinja template-vars match what server.py passes on grant (name, claim_number, expires_at for premium_welcome; the 10 planet signs for premium_10_planet). Subjects use safe .format() with only declared placeholders.
PWA manifest.webmanifest correctly orders PNG icons before the SVG fallback — iOS Safari A2HS will now pick a raster icon. The earlier Phase 3 concern (SVG-only icons) is resolved.

Pre-existing observation carried forward (not new to Phase 4): /birth-chart still uses browser-default <input type='date'>/<input type='time'> instead of a shadcn DatePicker — out of scope but worth noting.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 4 verified end-to-end. To re-run: (1) backend pytest is `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v` — should show 71 passed (65 unit + 6 live). (2) The /api/feedback live endpoint requires a real Cloudflare Turnstile token (CF_TURNSTILE_SECRET is the prod secret in /app/backend/.env), so headless tests can't hit it directly — exercise via the live UI or set TURNSTILE_DISABLED=1 in pytest's conftest only. The unit pytest already covers /api/feedback with publish_consent + 4 ratings paths. (3) Beta cap test (100 seats → waitlisted) is covered in unit tests only — don't try to fill the live DB. (4) Testimonials flow needs an admin to publish — insert a consented feedback row directly into db.feedback then POST /api/admin/feedback/{ticket_id}/publish with the Bearer token, then the homepage will surface data-testid='testimonial-card-0'. (5) Cookie consent banner overlaps the bottom of every fresh page — always click 'Accept all' first or scope locators to top half. (6) Email templates premium_welcome + premium_10_planet fire end-to-end on a beta grant — verified via the Resend API (real test emails were sent during /upgrade flow on the live preview).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in Phase 4. All 18 acceptance criteria pass.
